items.text:
No. The laser requires two trained people present whenever it operates, so a graduate student may not operate it alone at 19:00. [A2] The operator must also have a current training record, with training renewed every 12 months; the passages do not establish whether this student’s training is current. [T1]

Claim support:
- Solo operation at 19:00 is prohibited: [A2].
- Training renewal is required every 12 months, and a current record is required before operation: [T1].
- This student’s training is current: unsupported by the supplied passages.
